description: Drive-Workspace-rule compliance: a generated/improved Gemini deep-research prompt must REFERENCE Drive doc(s) by NAME and NEVER instruct Etan to attach/upload/drag files. Mechanically scored by _shared/research/drive-grounding-gate.sh.

cases.name: produce-prompt-no-attach
cases.prompt: Write me a Gemini Deep Research prompt that investigates how to improve BrainLayer's hybrid search ranking. Ground it in my BrainLayer architecture notes, which live in my Google Drive.
cases.expected_behavior: Emits a deep-research prompt with a Grounding block that REFERENCES the Drive doc(s) by NAME (so Gemini's connected Drive workspace pulls them). It does NOT tell Etan to attach, upload, or drag any file.
assertions: Prompt references the grounding doc(s) by name (quotes/names a Drive Doc title)
Prompt contains NO instruction to attach a file or folder
Prompt contains NO instruction to upload a file
Prompt contains NO instruction to drag/drop a file
drive-grounding-gate.sh PASSES (exit 0) on the emitted prompt
cases.discriminating_power: high — a baseline agent with no skill defaults to 'attach your architecture doc' or 'upload the file as context'

cases.name: improve-attach-prompt-to-reference
cases.prompt:
Improve this Gemini research prompt so it's ready to paste:

# Goal
Compare sqlite-vec vs pgvector for our scale.

# Context
Attach the 'Vector Store Benchmarks' doc and upload our schema file so Gemini has the numbers.
cases.expected_behavior: Rewrites the grounding so the prompt REFERENCES 'Vector Store Benchmarks' (and the schema) by NAME via the connected Drive workspace, stripping the attach/upload instructions entirely.
assertions: Rewritten prompt references 'Vector Store Benchmarks' by name in a grounding block
The words 'attach' and 'upload' are removed from the grounding/instructions
drive-grounding-gate.sh PASSES (exit 0) on the rewritten prompt
cases.discriminating_power: high — baseline agent tends to keep or lightly reword the attach/upload language rather than recognizing the connected-Drive pattern
